intel_custom.name: Custom RGB
intel_custom.description: An exportable software approximation inspired by the Intel Graphics Command Center settings in your recording. It is not an exact Intel display calibration.

reference.application: Intel Graphics Command Center — Display Color

software_mapping.note: These are deliberate software grading conventions, not a published Intel transfer function. The recording does not show the default saturation value.
software_mapping.formula: gain = 1 + (custom_contrast - recorded_default_contrast) * 0.02; offset = (1 - gain) * 0.5 + (custom_brightness - recorded_default_brightness) * 0.01; saturation = custom_saturation / 50

reference.viewing_note: Use Intel's original/default display colours when judging the software filter; applying both display and video grading changes the laptop preview twice. Physical screens can still differ.
